stories.summary: New laws taking effect this week will allow pubs, off-licences, nightclubs and restaurants in England and Wales to use biometric scanning technology for age checks. Customers can scan their faces on their phones to generate a QR code proving they are over 18, while traditional plastic identification will remain accepted.

links.headline: Digital ID comes of age as pubs and bars get go-ahead for biometric scan tech

stories.title: Jeju Air Crash Probe Focuses On Engine Damage After Bird Strike
stories.summary: Investigators examining the Jeju Air crash are focusing on engine damage following a bird strike. The pilots’ actions after the strike are also an early focus of the probe, according to people familiar with the investigation.

stories.title: Hamas Took More Than 200 Hostages From Israel. Here's What We Know.
stories.summary: Hamas took more than 200 hostages from Israel during the October 7 attack. Israel says 91 abductees remain in captivity, including the bodies of at least 34 people.
